Không bịa số liệu.","model":"SELECT_OPENROUTER_MODEL","fromEmail":"SET_SENDER_EMAIL","toEmail":"SET_APPROVER_EMAIL","cloudName":"SET_CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME","uploadPreset":"SET_UNSIGNED_UPLOAD_PRESET","graphVersion":"v23.0","kromossUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:8787","maxVersions":3}}];

const cfg=$('Configuration').first().json; const now=Date.now(); const rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json).filter(x=>x.postId && ["APPROVED","MANUAL_READY"].includes(x.status) && x.platform==='INSTAGRAM').filter(x=>Number.isFinite(Date.parse(x.scheduledAt)) && Date.parse(x.scheduledAt)<=now).sort((a,b)=>String(a.scheduledAt).localeCompare(String(b.scheduledAt))); return rows.slice(0,1).map(x=>({json:{...x,cfg}}));

const post=$('Select one post').first().json; const version=$input.first().json; if(!version.versionId || version.postId!==post.postId) throw new Error('Post version is missing or belongs to another post'); return [{json:{...post,version}}];

const rows=$input.all().map(x=>x.json).filter(x=>x.assetId).sort((a,b)=>Number(a.sortOrder)-Number(b.sortOrder)); if(!rows.length) throw new Error('No media is linked to this version'); return [{json:{...$('Version context').first().json,assetId:rows[0].assetId}}];

const asset=$input.first().json; if(asset.status!=='READY' || !/^https:\/\//.test(asset.publicUrl||'')) throw new Error('A READY public HTTPS image is required'); return [{json:{...$('Choose media').first().json,asset}}];

const c=$('Media context').first().json;const account=$input.first().json;if(!account.externalAccountId||account.platform!==c.platform)throw new Error('Active platform account is missing');if(c.currentVersionId!==c.approvedVersionId)throw new Error('Approved version is stale');if(!Number.isFinite(Date.parse(c.scheduledAt))||Date.parse(c.scheduledAt)>Date.now())return [];return [{json:{...c,account,publicationId:c.postId+'-'+c.approvedVersionId,idempotencyKey:c.postId+'-'+c.approvedVersionId,caption:[c.version.caption,c.version.hashtags].filter(Boolean).join('\n\n')}}];
